summary: Project involves a live list app with admin panel, comment lists, earnings, and authorization controls.
architectural_notes: Admin users must be recognized as valid users for all gated actions (comment lists, uploads, etc.)
known_issues: Authorization error: Admin users receive 'Unauthorized: Only users can add comment lists' when performing actions in the Admin Panel

existing_features.title: Remove the separate 'Earnings' tab from the main navigation in App.tsx and merge its content (the EarningsChecker view) directly into the Live Checker tab/view, so users can access earnings lookup within the Live List/Live Checker section without a separate tab.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix authorization error: Admin users incorrectly rejected when creating comment lists or uploading (Unauthorized: Only users can add comment lists)
Remove separate Earnings tab and merge its content into the Live List tab

Fix the backend authorization logic so that Admin users (principals with admin role) are accepted for all actions currently gated to 'users only', including creating comment lists, adding templates, uploading, and any other actions that currently throw 'Unauthorized: Only users can add comment lists'. Admins must be treated as authorized for all user-level operations.

projectName: Fix Admin Authorization Error & Merge Earnings into Live List Tab
